text:
sanjay: Hey @people-ops I’ll be in Bermuda for 6 weeks this summer (2026-06-02 - 2026-07-14). Do I need to update anything for WFH stipend shipping/payroll? Also worried about tax nexus—will this trigger a business presence? :thinking:
cleo: Heads-up — Bermuda has no personal income tax but there are payroll implications in some cases (employer presence). People ops usually asks for homebase declaration + travel docs. Tagging @people-ops
people-ops: Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up! Short answers: (1) WFH stipend: we prorate if your declared homebase changes; (2) Payroll: we need to know if you'll stay on US payroll or switch — usually you remain on US payroll for short stays; (3) Tax nexus: 6 weeks is typically low risk, but it depends on in-country customer/partner activity. Please fill the Travel & Remote Stays form so we can loop in Finance and Legal. Form link: https://redwood.company/forms/travel-remote-stays
people-ops: Please include: 
```
- country: Bermuda
- start_date: 2026-06-02
- end_date: 2026-07-14
- shipping_address for stipend/equipment
- any meetings with customers or co-located partner work
```
We'll confirm within 3 business days.
finance-bot: FYI — if you remain on US payroll no immediate payroll changes, but shipping equipment to Bermuda may need customs paperwork and cost-center approval. Stipend proration calc we use: monthly_amount * days_out / 30 (it's a manual adjustment, finance will post final).
ev an: Also check benefits — health plan international coverage can change if you’re abroad >30 days. People-ops can flag benefits for you.
sanjay: Thanks — I won't be meeting customers, just remote work and a small local meetup with devs. I'll fill the form today. Quick Q: can we ship my extra monitor there? :ship:
people-ops: You can, but we need the exact shipping address and confirmation the monitor is personal and will be re-imported to the US after the trip. Customs in Bermuda sometimes requires a temporary import bond — Finance will advise. Alternatively we can issue a stipend to cover local purchase instead of shipping.
cleo: Also reminder: declare temporary homebase in the Homebase tool so expense coding and payroll flags are accurate. Homebase change triggers benefits and payroll checks.
sanjay: Filled the form: https://redwood.company/forms/resp/2135678901 — included shipping address and noted no customer meetings. Thanks!
people-ops: Got it, Sanjay. We’ll review and loop in Legal/Finance. Expect a DM from finance in 1-2 business days re: shipping options and stipend proration. If your dates or plan change, please update the form immediately. :thumbsup:
finance-bot: Noted. If shipping proceeds -> we’ll estimate customs fee and recommend an insured courier; will post options in this thread shortly.
